name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Animated placeholder block that marks loading layout regions without colour literals.
docs: Size Skeleton with utility classes such as h-4 w-48 or size-10 rounded-full. The element is aria-hidden by default and disables its pulse under prefers-reduced-motion.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <div
    aria-hidden="true"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('rounded-control bg-control motion-safe:animate-pulse', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  />
</template>
